def main(width, height, cells, player, boxes, moves):
    boxes = list(boxes)
    delta = [-width, 1, width, -1]
    hist = []
    read = pushes = blocked = undos = dead = 0
    for m in moves:
        if all(cells[b] == 2 for b in boxes):
            break
        read += 1
        if m == 4:
            if hist:
                d, k = hist.pop()
                player -= delta[d]
                if k >= 0:
                    boxes[k] -= delta[d]
                undos += 1
            continue
        t = player + delta[m]
        if cells[t] == 1:
            blocked += 1
            continue
        if t in boxes:
            k = boxes.index(t)
            u = t + delta[m]
            if cells[u] == 1 or u in boxes:
                blocked += 1
                continue
            boxes[k] = u
            player = t
            pushes += 1
            hist.append((m, k))
            if (cells[u] != 2
                    and (cells[u - width] == 1 or cells[u + width] == 1)
                    and (cells[u - 1] == 1 or cells[u + 1] == 1)):
                dead += 1
        else:
            player = t
            hist.append((m, -1))
    solved = all(cells[b] == 2 for b in boxes)
    return (player, boxes, read, len(hist), pushes, blocked, undos, dead, solved)

def main(ratings, rounds, results):
    n = len(ratings)
    score = [0] * n
    played = [set() for _ in range(n)]
    opps = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    whites = [0] * n
    last = [None] * n
    had_bye = [False] * n
    rematches = 0
    ri = 0
    for _ in range(rounds):
        order = sorted(range(n), key=lambda p: (-score[p], -ratings[p], p))
        bye = None
        if n % 2 == 1:
            for p in reversed(order):
                if not had_bye[p]:
                    bye = p
                    break
            had_bye[bye] = True
            score[bye] += 2
            order = [p for p in order if p != bye]
        unpaired = list(order)
        pairs = []
        while unpaired:
            p = unpaired.pop(0)
            q = None
            for x in unpaired:
                if x not in played[p]:
                    q = x
                    break
            if q is None:
                q = unpaired[0]
                rematches += 1
            unpaired.remove(q)
            if whites[p] < whites[q]:
                w, b = p, q
            elif whites[q] < whites[p]:
                w, b = q, p
            else:
                pb = last[p] == 'b'
                qb = last[q] == 'b'
                if pb and not qb:
                    w, b = p, q
                elif qb and not pb:
                    w, b = q, p
                else:
                    w, b = p, q
            pairs.append((w, b))
        for w, b in pairs:
            r = results[ri]
            ri += 1
            if r == 0:
                score[w] += 2
            elif r == 1:
                score[w] += 1
                score[b] += 1
            else:
                score[b] += 2
            whites[w] += 1
            last[w] = 'w'
            last[b] = 'b'
            played[w].add(b)
            played[b].add(w)
            opps[w].append(b)
            opps[b].append(w)
    buch = [sum(score[o] for o in opps[p]) for p in range(n)]
    ranking = sorted(range(n), key=lambda p: (-score[p], -buch[p], -ratings[p], p))
    return (score, buch, ranking, whites, rematches)
